address: Daħla Ta' Għajn Damma Street, Xagħra, XRA 9010, Malta
bio: Set in a lovely old farmhouse with breathtaking views of the Xaghra countryside, this restaurant offers a refined and relaxing ambience. The talented chef crafts a unique and personalised score, blending Mediterranean and creative flavours. During the summer, be sure to book a table on the delightful garden terrace. The restaurant also boasts an extensive wine cellar with over 700 premium labels.
